payload.friendly_name: single_branch planning pin across a rebase
payload.purpose_context: After a mid-mission rebase, finalize-tasks --refresh-planning-commit --allow-orphaned re-points planning_commit_sha to the branch tip, the single_branch evidence window planning_commit..mission_branch empties, and move-task refuses SINGLE_BRANCH_IMPLEMENTATION_MISSING (#7793). The same pin authority also replaces a derived pin on a later plain finalize, walks the wrong branch, prints messages that disagree, can be too early or too late, and leaves doctor gaps (#7297 items 1-6).
payload.purpose_tldr: Keep the single_branch planning pin on the planning commit across a rebase, so the implementation evidence window never empties.
